app.notes: The audio pipeline in pocket-ui's player is more robust across ROCKNIX devices. This update gives H700 handhelds a larger buffer and fixes a startup dropout and silent blocks when audio runs short. SD images remain at 0.2.0: flash, then update over Wi-Fi.
